h: From the Turmoil of the Journey to Shabbos Rest

p: הַמַּאֲמָר הַזֶּה הוּא מִכְּתַב יַד קָדְשׁוֹ
This maamar is from his holy manuscript,
"They shall blow a teruah for their journeys" (Bamidbar 10:6),
"you shall blow a tekiah and not a teruah" (Bamidbar 10:7).
For teruah is rendered in the Targum as "wailing,"
"When you go to war in your land
"and on the day of your rejoicing," etc.,
And when a person journeys on the road,
he is in turmoil and distress,
and he is not at rest.
"We exclude from 'when you walk on the way'
for journeying was with a teruah,
while gathering was at the time of encampment,
when they were at rest and in joy,
and the signal was with a tekiah.
And it is known that the forty-two journeys
וְכָל אוֹת הוּא מַדְרֵגָה בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ
and each letter is a level of its own;
and between one level and the next
and then he is in turmoil;
and when he reaches the level,
And this is the whole of man (Koheles 12:13):
all the days of his life, on the workdays,
and it is preparation to come to Shabbos;
for "one who did not toil on Erev Shabbos
what will he eat on Shabbos?" (Avodah Zarah 3a).
And so it is also in spiritual matters:
for according to how a person sanctifies himself
so does he sense the holiness (on Shabbos).
And in Pri Etz Chaim he wrote
that on the fourth, fifth and sixth days,
one prepares to receive nefesh, ruach and neshamah,
and the first, second and third days,
are the residue of the holiness of nefesh, ruach and neshamah
the three days after Shabbos too,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יוּכַל גַּם כֵּן
and through this one can also
sanctify the three days preceding Shabbos
"Were they to keep two Shabbosos according to their law,
that is, in receiving the additional soul
according to its law and properly,
and he has a much greater preparation
from the leaven in the dough
and the subjugation of the kingdoms,
for according to the strengthening of the evil inclination
and the leaven in the heart of a Jew,
so is the strengthening of the dominion
of the kings of the earth,
whose power is from that same power of evil
that has strengthened itself in the souls of the Jews

p: דְּעַל כֵּן לֹא אָמַר לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה
that therefore Moshe did not tell them
when the bread of two days was doubled for them,
although he had already been commanded on the first day:
for then, since there had been no prior Shabbos,
the additional holiness of nefesh, ruach and neshamah
in the three days preceding Shabbos,
and the preparation of Erev Shabbos sufficed,
וְהֵכִינוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר וְגוֹ׳ (שְׁמוֹת טז, ה)
But Hashem, may He be blessed,
אָמַר לוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ (שְׁמוֹת טז, כח)
for the preparation of the six workdays
so that they would no longer have gone
וּמִצְוַת זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ
And the mitzvah of "Remember the Shabbos day to sanctify it"
"from the first day of your week for your Shabbos";
remembrance in the heart, at least)
that his heart should yearn and long
along the lines of the Gemara's use of
for all his days while he is alive
with the war of the evil inclination
and the toil of the soul
in accepting the yoke of Torah and mitzvos,
that one should always be like an ox to the yoke
and like a donkey to the load.
And they said in Perek Chelek
that He loaded him with mitzvos and sufferings
And at the end of chapter 2 of Berachos (17a):
And this is so even for those who accept
all the more so when there is upon him
also the yoke of the kingdom
and the yoke of worldly occupation
for included in the subjugation of the kingdoms
are all the troubles of this world;
דְּבֶן דָּוִד יָבוֹא גַּם בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת
that the son of David may come even on Erev Shabbos,
and we are not concerned about the toil of Shabbos
and one need no longer toil
and at their passing, "his soul rested."
for it has comforted them from the evil inclination
The Name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
that Shabbos is not a name of the day,
for the day does not rest;
אֶלָּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שָׁבַת בּוֹ
rather, the Holy One, blessed be He, rested on it
and saw that everything was very good.
And all the Names of Hashem, may He be blessed,
And this is "complete on all sides":
And likewise the additional soul of Shabbos,
which is "a portion of God Above,"
וְהִיא גַּם כֵּן כָּל שְׁלִימוּ בָּהּ
and it too has all perfection in it
and is a taste of the World to Come,
over which the evil inclination has no dominion.
And according to how he prepared himself
through his toil in the service of Hashem
so is his sense of rest
וְעַל כֵּן תִּיקֵּן הַבַּעַל שֵׁם טוֹב
And therefore the Baal Shem Tov instituted
for then one goes out of turmoil
who, when they reach settled land,
for so Hashem, may He be blessed, established
And similarly He created day and night,
"Seven times the righteous one falls and rises."
and Hashem, may He be blessed, then brings
"To know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you."
from his sorrow of the weekdays,
"In sorrow you shall eat of it";
and as written in Bereishis Rabbah (11:1)
עַל פָּסוּק וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי
on the pasuk "And He blessed the seventh day":
וְלֹא יוֹסִף עֶצֶב עִמָּהּ (מִשְׁלֵי י, כב)
and He adds no sorrow with it" (Mishlei 10:22);
the curses of Adam and Chavah,
and on Shabbos they have no dominion.

p: and the encampment and the rest
they would blow on Erev Shabbos
for the tekiah is the signal of encampment,
and with the first tekiah of Erev Shabbos
they would gather the people in the fields,
who had to come in together,
that in Bavel they cease from work
the custom of their fathers is in their hands.
that from when they were exiled to Bavel
which correspond to the three Avos;
is for the attribute of the Fear of Yitzchak,
to dread and fear Hashem, may He be blessed.
as written in Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu:
"My fear is from within my joy,
and my joy from within my fear."
as written in the holy Zohar
at the beginning of Parshas Acharei,
from the verse "Serve Hashem in fear" (Tehillim 2:11),
and the verse "What does Hashem ask
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב גַּם כֵּן (תְּהִלִּים קיא, י)
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem"
fear does not come to a person
that Hashem, may He be blessed
"the whole earth is full of His glory"
at the beginning of Orach Chaim.
And from his taking to heart
that Hashem, may He be blessed, looks upon him
there comes also joy before the fear;
"Let the heart of those who seek Hashem rejoice":
Hashem, may He be blessed, does not shine
כִּי עוֹז וְחֶדְוָה בִּמְקוֹמוֹ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א טז, כז)
for "strength and gladness are in His place" (Divrei HaYamim I 16:27).
And as it says in Nechemiah (1:11):
who desire to fear Your Name."
like one standing before the King;
and he has not fulfilled his obligation.
דְּזֶה שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לוֹ כְּלָל לְדַבֵּר
For this one, who cannot speak at all,
but when he is fit to speak,
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין לִבּוֹ מְכַוֵּין
even though his heart does not intend
as one standing and speaking before the King,
And since one who stands before the King
and the awe of the King
that they desire and long to fear,
as ones standing before Him, may He be blessed,
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁעֲדַיִין אֵינוֹ כֵּן
even though it is not yet so.
wants only the will of the heart,
and that the inclination disturbs his heart
so that he cannot direct his heart properly
and as one truly standing before Hashem
he is like one who was prevented by force
as if he had done it;
and the Holy One, blessed be He, hears
as if he had directed his heart,
since He sees into the heart
is to be standing before the King.
even though it does not yet shine in his heart,
and from this he comes to fear.
that opens further in his heart
that Hashem, may He be blessed, stands over him
and sees his deeds and his thoughts
and the hidden places of his heart,
joy in Hashem will return to him.

paragraphs.text: Source: Tehillim 149:2 — “ישמח ישראל בעשיו בני ציון יגילו במלכם” — “Let Israel rejoice in its maker;let the children of Zion exult in their monarch.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Tehillim 105:3 — “התהללו בשם קדשו ישמח לב  מבקשי יהוה” — “Exult in this holy name;let all who seek GOD rejoice.”
